dogecoin.text: What people have found very unintuitive in the crypto space is the multitude of coins. In most case, coins serve identical functions.  One can argue that Bitcoin serves an identical function as Dogecoin, therefore their value should be identical!

I'm also the same guy who sold off every DOGE coin that I could mine when it first came out.  I was mining it for two weeks at a $20 profit per day.  Today that 2 weeks would have been worth $1.6 m today.
